_comment: --cms=none: lib/cms is deleted, but proxy.ts is the locale-rewrite middleware (not CMS code) and imports one helper from it — `isHomeSlug`, used to redirect /home → /. Inline the helper (it's a pure string check over a fixed slug list, verbatim from lib/cms/core.ts) instead of deleting the middleware. The rest of proxy.ts's Prepr behaviour is gated on the NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_PROVIDER env var, which a no-CMS shop never sets, so it stays inert without patching.
